item.title: Opinion: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' Features the Wrong Godzilla Monster
item.description: Life is all about the choices you make. On Nov. 19, I chose to go to the cinema to watch Godzilla: Minus Zero instead of playing GTA 6 . I regret it. I expected a sequel to Takashi Yamazaki’s somber, tragic reflection on loss, trauma, and violence in Godzilla: Minus One . Instead, I got the next entry in the Monsterverse franchise.

item.title: Every Eevee Evolution, Ranked From Worst To Best
item.description: Eevee, the adorable Normal-type Pokémon first introduced in Pokémon Red and Blue , has become something of an unofficial second mascot for the franchise, thanks to its supreme cuteness and near-ubiquity throughout the mainline games. Beyond that, Eevee's ability to evolve into a whopping eight distinct forms (or Eeveelutions, as they're affectionately known), each with a different typing, makes it something of a blank canvas for exploring different battle styles and strategies.

item.title: 10 Games With Permadeath That Are 10/10 Masterpieces
item.description: There’s something reassuring about knowing you can pick up some extra lives in a video game, ever since the days of Super Mario Bros. and Pac-Man . When your character dies, the action resumes right where you left off — or pretty close to it. You don’t lose much progress. Things can continue largely as they were.

item.title: Shrek 5 Teaser Officially Reveals New Look, and Fans Are Divided
item.description: Shrek 5 was announced in the summer of 2024 and initially scheduled to release in July 2026. After a couple of delays, DreamWorks settled on a summer 2027 launch for Shrek 5 . With only a few months to go until its release, fans are eager to learn more about how life has been treating the inhabitants of the swamp.

item.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave’s Fan-Favorite Hero Is Definitely a Secret Vampire
item.description: Ever since the release of Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave back in September, fans of the series have been arguing about which of the Four Flame Lords they like best. For my money, it’s Dietrich. That’s mostly because his route features the best supporting cast (i.e. Fabio and Esmeralda) and includes the most lore that connects to Three Houses . I also prefer Dietrich because I’m 100% convinced that he is a vampire, even if Fortune’s Weave never comes out and says so explicitly. In honor of Polygon’s annual Fangsgiving extravaganza, here are five reasons why Dietrich is totally a vampire.

item.title: Persona Studio Director Wants Younger Developers To Help Shape Persona 6
item.description: P-Studio chief director Kazuhisa Wada shared his hopes for the future of the Persona series, including Persona 6 , in a new interview with IGN. After reflecting on his own journey as a developer, Wada voiced his openness to letting Atlus and P-Studio's next generation of developers influence the direction of Persona 6 and the future of the popular RPG franchise.

item.title: 58-Years Later, 'Blade Runner' Finally Adapts Philip K. Dick’s Weirdest Idea From the Book
item.description: More than half a century later, that detail finally made it to the screen in Prime Video’s Blade Runner 2099 . Hints of Mercerism pop up early on signs and billboards in showrunner Silka Luisa's sequel series. But episode six fully delves into the concept as Cora (Hunter Schafer), a human fugitive pretending to be a Replicant Blade Runner, returns to the abandoned Mercerite monastery where she grew up in search of a memory hidden by her mother Helena (Sheila Atim). There she encounters a Mercerite looking to spread the faith by restarting the broadcast of Mercer’s ordeal.

item.title: GTA 6's Long Development Cycle Even Made Rockstar Question If It Would Ever Launch
item.description: While Grand Theft Auto 6 is real, out now, and breaking all sorts of records with how well it's selling , it felt like the game might never be released at some points during its lengthy 13-year development. In a recent interview, Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson revealed that even those within Rockstar sometimes felt that way about GTA 6 .

item.title: So, Did GTA 6 Live up to the Hype?
item.description: Thirteen years — that’s how long players waited to get their hands on Grand Theft Auto 6 . The road to Rockstar’s mega-hit was an unusually long one for a bankable franchise video game, but the wait was arguably an even better marketing tactic than that flashy Netflix reveal. Hype came to define GTA 6 : It birthed memes, fueled impatient YouTube chat spam, and spawned a cottage industry of so-called leakers who only made the game feel larger-than-life in the absence of official details. For many, the anticipation of GTA 6 became a game in and of itself.
